standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Homology, Lemma labelled homology-lemma-long-exact-sequence-cochain (canonical Stacks tag 0117); invoked at proof line 1084
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the connecting homomorphisms and the long exact sequence; the functoriality of the construction is the part the author omits.

core_obligations: Get exactness of the complex functor: by the preceding lemma a short exact sequence 0 -> F_1 -> F_2 -> F_3 -> 0 of presheaves of O_X-modules is turned into a short exact sequence of complexes of O_X(U)-modules, so the long exact sequence machinery becomes available (proof lines 1077-1083).

Produce the boundary maps: apply the long exact sequence lemma for cochain complexes to obtain the connecting homomorphisms delta from Cech cohomology of F_3 in degree n to that of F_1 in degree n+1, together with the corresponding long exact sequence (proof lines 1084-1089).

Complete the delta-functor: compatibility of these maps with maps between short exact sequences of presheaves is the remaining axiom, and the author leaves that verification to the reader (proof lines 1089-1091).
proof_roadmap: Use exactness of the Cech complex functor to turn a short exact sequence of presheaves into a short exact sequence of complexes (proof lines 1077-1083).
Apply the standard construction of connecting maps for cochain complexes to define the boundary maps (proof lines 1084-1089).
Leave the compatibility check with maps of short exact sequences to the reader, which is the last axiom of a delta-functor (proof lines 1089-1091).
difficulty_reason: The lemma equips the Cech cohomology functors of a fixed open covering of a ringed space with the structure of a cohomological delta-functor on presheaves of O_X-modules, with values in O_X(U)-modules (statement lines 1067-1073). The proof is a short reduction: the exactness lemma in the same section converts a short exact sequence of presheaves into a short exact sequence of complexes, which is precisely the input needed for the standard construction of connecting maps and the long exact sequence (proof lines 1077-1089); the compatibility with maps of short exact sequences, the last axiom, is explicitly omitted by the author and that sentence is reproduced as written. The claim is H2: one cited construction applied to a cited exactness result, with the linear structure carried along.
